blocks.title: A picture that does not change

blocks.description: The vector notas held a 7 when the snapshot was taken; a 9 was added afterwards. The picture, with a padlock, keeps only the 7: it can be read but not written.

caption.text: The snapshot copies the whole content. Whatever happens to the original afterwards does not affect the picture.
